points.title: 少年成长
points.description: 汉尼拔出生于迦太基的一个显赫军事家族，父亲哈米尔卡·巴卡是迦太基的著名将领。从小就被父亲培养为军事家，据说父亲让他发誓终身与罗马为敌。在第一次布匿战争后，迦太基失去西西里岛，汉尼拔亲眼目睹了国家面临的困境。他在迦太基接受了全面的希腊式教育，精通多种语言，并展现出非凡的军事才能。这段时期的学习和家族熏陶为他后来的军事生涯奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: Hannibal was born into a prominent Carthaginian military family; his father Hamilcar Barca was a renowned general. From a young age, he was groomed as a military leader, with his father reportedly making him swear an oath of eternal enmity towards Rome. After the First Punic War, Carthage lost Sicily, and Hannibal witnessed the困境 his country faced. He received a comprehensive Greek-style education in Carthage, mastered multiple languages, and demonstrated exceptional military talent. This period of learning and family upbringing laid the solid foundation for his later military career.

points.title: 征服扩张
points.description: 汉尼拔被任命为迦太基在伊比利亚半岛的军队统帅。他迅速征服了伊比利亚东南部地区，建立了强大的军事基地和财政来源。他通过联姻和结盟巩固了对当地部落的影响力，并组建了一支包括战象在内的多样化军队。在萨贡托(Saguntum)与罗马发生冲突后，汉尼拔不顾罗马的最后通牒，围攻并占领了这座城市，这成为第二次布匿战争的导火索。他在伊比利亚的成功为后来的远征罗马奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Hannibal was appointed commander of Carthaginian forces in the Iberian Peninsula. He quickly conquered southeastern Iberia, establishing a powerful military base and financial resource. He consolidated his influence over local tribes through marriage alliances and formed a diverse army including war elephants. After conflict with Rome over Saguntum, Hannibal, despite Rome's ultimatum, besieged and captured the city, which became the trigger for the Second Punic War. His success in Iberia laid the foundation for his later expedition against Rome.

points.title: 远征意大利
points.description: 汉尼拔做出了军事史上最惊人的决策之一——率领军队翻越阿尔卑斯山进入意大利。他率领约9万名士兵和37头战象，克服了严寒、地形险峻和高山反应等困难，成功穿越了被认为不可逾越的阿尔卑斯山脉。这一行动完全出乎罗马人意料，使汉尼拔能够在意大利本土开辟第二战场。在特雷比亚河(Trebia)和特拉西梅诺湖(Trasimene)战役中，汉尼拔运用卓越的战术接连击败罗马军队，展现了非凡的军事才能和领导力。
points.descriptionEn: Hannibal made one of the most remarkable decisions in military history—leading his army across the Alps into Italy. He led approximately 90,000 soldiers and 37 war elephants, overcoming difficulties such as extreme cold, treacherous terrain, and mountain sickness, successfully crossing the Alps, which were considered impassable. This move completely surprised the Romans, allowing Hannibal to open a second front in Italian territory. At the battles of the Trebia River and Lake Trasimene, Hannibal used brilliant tactics to defeat Roman forces in succession, demonstrating extraordinary military talent and leadership.

points.title: 辉煌胜利
points.description: 公元前216年，汉尼拔在坎尼战役中取得了军事史上最伟大的胜利之一。面对数量占优的罗马军队(约8.6万人)，汉尼拔采用了经典的包围战术，将罗马军队完全包围并歼灭。这场战役导致罗马军队约7万人伤亡，是罗马军事史上最惨重的失败。坎尼战役展示了汉尼拔作为战术大师的非凡才能，他的战术被后世军事学家广泛研究和学习。然而，尽管取得了如此辉煌的胜利，汉尼拔未能攻占罗马城，也无法迫使罗马接受和平，这成为他战略上的一个重大局限。
points.descriptionEn: In 216 BC, Hannibal achieved one of the greatest victories in military history at the Battle of Cannae. Facing a numerically superior Roman army (about 86,000 men), Hannibal employed the classic envelopment tactic, completely surrounding and annihilating the Roman forces. This battle resulted in approximately 70,000 Roman casualties, Rome's most devastating defeat in military history. The Battle of Cannae demonstrated Hannibal's extraordinary talent as a tactical master, and his tactics have been widely studied and learned by later military strategists. However, despite this glorious victory, Hannibal failed to capture Rome and could not force Rome to accept peace, which became a significant limitation in his strategy.

points.title: 流亡终老
points.description: 第二次布匿战争后期，汉尼拔被迫离开意大利，返回迦太基。在扎马战役(Zama)中，汉尼拔被西庇阿(Scipio Africanus)击败，迦太基被迫接受和平条件。战后，汉尼拔成为迦太基的行政官，进行了一系列改革以增强国家实力，但遭到贵族反对。公元前196年，罗马人要求引渡汉尼拔，他被迫流亡，先后前往塞琉古帝国、克里米亚和最终的小亚细亚的比提尼亚。在比提尼亚，他协助国王与罗马作战，但在罗马的压力下，公元前183年，汉尼拔选择服毒自杀，结束了他传奇而悲剧的一生。
points.descriptionEn: In the later stages of the Second Punic War, Hannibal was forced to leave Italy and return to Carthage. At the Battle of Zama, Hannibal was defeated by Scipio Africanus, and Carthage was forced to accept peace terms. After the war, Hannibal became a suffete (chief magistrate) of Carthage and implemented a series of reforms to strengthen the state, but faced opposition from the aristocracy. In 196 BC, Romans demanded Hannibal's extradition, and he was forced into exile, successively going to the Seleucid Empire, Crimea, and finally Bithynia in Anatolia. In Bithynia, he assisted the king in fighting against Rome, but under Roman pressure, in 183 BC, Hannibal chose to commit suicide by poison, ending his legendary and tragic life.

appraisal.zh: 汉尼拔被军事史学家誉为历史上最伟大的军事天才之一，翻越阿尔卑斯山与坎尼战役的包围战术成为军事史经典，他统率跨文化、多种族军队的领导才能也备受称道，其坚韧不屈的精神激励后世无数军事家。然而，另一种看法认为他的战略存在根本缺陷：战场胜利未能转化为政治成果，既未攻占罗马，也未迫使罗马求和，过度依赖个人才能而忽视后勤与长期战争，扩张政策最终招致迦太基的毁灭。
appraisal.en: Hannibal is hailed by military historians as one of the greatest military geniuses in history: his crossing of the Alps and the envelopment at Cannae are classics of military history, his leadership of a multicultural, multi-ethnic army is widely praised, and his resilience has inspired countless later commanders. Yet another view holds that his strategy had fundamental flaws: battlefield victories were never converted into political gains, he neither took Rome nor forced it to sue for peace, relied too heavily on personal talent while neglecting logistics and long-term sustainability, and his expansionism ultimately brought about Carthage's destruction.

supporter.zh: 汉尼拔被军事史学家誉为历史上最伟大的军事天才之一。他展现了非凡的战略眼光和战术创新，尤其是翻越阿尔卑斯山的壮举和坎尼战役中的包围战术，成为军事史上的经典案例。他超越了时代的局限，建立了跨文化、多种族的军队，展现了卓越的领导才能。汉尼拔的精神遗产在于他面对强大敌人时的坚韧不拔和永不言弃的精神，激励了后世无数军事家和革命者。
supporter.en: Hannibal is regarded by military historians as one of the greatest military geniuses in history. He demonstrated extraordinary strategic vision and tactical innovation, particularly his daring crossing of the Alps and the envelopment tactic at Cannae, which have become classic cases in military history. He transcended the limitations of his time, building a multicultural, multi-ethnic army and showing exceptional leadership. Hannibal's legacy lies in his resilience and never-say-die spirit when facing powerful enemies, inspiring countless military leaders and revolutionaries throughout history.

critic.zh: 批评者认为汉尼拔的战略存在根本性缺陷。尽管他在战场上取得了辉煌胜利，却未能将军事胜利转化为政治成果，未能攻占罗马城或迫使罗马接受和平。他的战略过于依赖个人军事才能，而忽视了后勤和长期战争的可持续性。此外，汉尼拔的扩张主义政策最终导致迦太基的毁灭，使迦太基人民付出了惨重代价。从现代道德角度看，他使用战象等残酷战争手段也受到质疑。
critic.en: Critics argue that Hannibal's strategy had fundamental flaws. Despite his brilliant battlefield victories, he failed to convert military success into political gains, unable to capture Rome or force it to accept peace. His strategy relied too heavily on personal military talent while neglecting logistics and sustainability of long-term warfare. Furthermore, Hannibal's expansionist policies ultimately led to the destruction of Carthage, causing heavy casualties for the Carthaginian people. From a modern moral perspective, his use of cruel warfare methods such as war elephants is also questioned.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，汉尼拔被视为第二次布匿战争的关键人物和古代最杰出的军事指挥官之一。他的战术创新和战场成就被广泛研究，成为军事院校的经典案例。在流行文化中，汉尼拔常被描绘为反抗罗马霸权的英雄形象，象征着不屈不挠的斗争精神。然而，现代历史研究也强调了他的战略局限性和对迦太基悲剧结局的责任。汉尼拔的一生反映了古代地中海世界权力斗争的复杂性，以及个人才能与历史大势之间的张力。
objective.en: In historical academia, Hannibal is regarded as a key figure of the Second Punic War and one of the most outstanding military commanders of antiquity. His tactical innovations and battlefield achievements have been extensively studied and serve as classic cases in military academies. In popular culture, Hannibal is often depicted as a hero resisting Roman hegemony, symbolizing an indomitable fighting spirit. However, modern historical research also emphasizes his strategic limitations and responsibility for Carthage's tragic fate. Hannibal's life reflects the complexity of power struggles in the ancient Mediterranean world and the tension between individual talent and historical trends.

self.zh: 我将要么带着胜利返回迦太基，要么躺在自己的棺材里回去。
self.en: I shall either return to Carthage as a conqueror, or not return at all.
